channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Judge expresses skepticism toward Epstein victim lawsuit against big banks alleging they facilitated sex-trafficking
item.description: The Jeffrey Epstein victims' lawsuits resembled two others, against JPMorgan Chase and Deutsche Bank, which settled for hundreds of millions.

item.title: THEN AND NOW: The cast of 'Newsies' 33 years later
item.description: The Disney musical was a box-office flop. Now, it's considered a treasure that helped launch Christian Bale's career. Here's what the cast is up to.

item.title: Merriam-Webster just released its word of the year. 2025 words of the year say a lot about the AI world users can't quit
item.description: From Glassdoor's "fatigue" to Oxford Dictionary's "rage bait," the words of 2025 is reflecting a sense of exhaustion and inability to opt-out.

item.title: 'SNL' spoofed Uber Eats Wrapped. Then Uber actually did it for real.
item.description: "SNL" made a skit where a character found out how much chicken nuggets he ate from an imaginary Uber Wrapped. On Monday, the company launched a recap.

item.title: Trump sues the BBC for $5 billion, alleging defamation over January 6 documentary
item.description: The defamation lawsuit's allegations focus on the footage of President Donald Trump's January 6, 2021, speech.

item.title: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis' election night coat sold at auction for $50,800. Photos show the iconic look.
item.description: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis wore a purple maternity coat on election night in 1960. Sotheby's estimated the coat's value at between $6,000 and $8,000.

item.title: Brooklyn man, 23, is charged in $15 million Coinbase 'customer-care' scheme
item.description: Ronald Spektor, 23, has been charged with impersonating a Coinbase customer care representative to trick victims into turning over their passwords.

item.title: Claude Code's creator explains the limits of vibe coding
item.description: The engineer behind Claude Code says vibe coding works for prototypes, but today's AI models still fall short for maintainable software.

item.title: Chris Hemsworth says caring for his dad with Alzheimer's has reshaped his priorities as a father
item.description: Regardless of the experiences and material things that money can offer, at the end of the day, kids "just want your time," Chris Hemsworth said.

item.title: What is Elon Musk's net worth? Find out the wealth of the Tesla, SpaceX CEO
item.description: Elon Musk's net worth of over $600 billion makes him among the world's richest people. His wealth is closely tied to shares of his car company, Tesla.
